kaag laai bel pakyo, harsha na bismat
khane mukh lai junga le chekdaina

A: man sudhha bhaye jaha pani pabitra

Question (Nepali): aakash ko fal aakha tari mar
aafno agadi aang ko bhaisi nadekhne
naulo kura ma nau din ramailo
thorei ko lobh ma dherai gumaunu
